scripts.migrate:up: pnpm --filter @kg/adapter-postgres run build && node --env-file=.env scripts/migrate.mjs up
scripts.migrate:down: pnpm --filter @kg/adapter-postgres run build && node --env-file=.env scripts/migrate.mjs down
scripts.explorer:api: pnpm --filter @kg/core run build && pnpm --filter @kg/api run build && node --env-file=.env packages/api/dist/index.js
scripts.explorer:web: pnpm --filter @kg/core run build && node scripts/clear-web-vite-cache.mjs && pnpm --filter @kg/web run start
scripts.explorer:build: pnpm --filter @kg/api run build && pnpm --filter @kg/web run build
scripts.test:explorer: vitest run --project unit packages/api packages/core/src/explorer packages/adapter-postgres/src/repositories/graph-read-repository.test.ts && vitest run --project integration packages/api packages/adapter-postgres/src/graph-read.integration.test.ts && pnpm --filter @kg/web run test && pnpm --filter @kg/web run e2e
